messages:
maria-peopleops: Quick Q — Trent flagged a promoted IC (Yasmin) approved for a band move effective 2027-01-01. He asked whether we can make the comp retro to 1/1 even though we missed our usual payroll cutoff.
trent-engmgr: We need parity with offers were sending this week. Is there any way to fast-track retro so internal comp aligns with external offers?
yasmin-ic: Also curious if the retro or exception changes my bonus calculation for Q1.
luis-peopleops: Short answer: exceptions are possible but limited. Payroll can process manual journal entries to apply retro after cutoff, but that requires a formal exception request, comp ops signoff, and approval from People Ops leadership. Theres also extra reconciliation work and potential tax adjustments.
payroll-bot: Reminder: standard cutoff to affect the mid-month payroll run is the 10th. Exception requests that need same-cycle processing should be filed and acknowledged by payroll by the 8th to allow manual handling.
maria-peopleops: Practical next step: open an HR case titled "Payroll Exception - Retro 2027-01-01", attach manager+director approvals and the calibration note, and include a short business justification explaining recruiting parity risk. CC people-ops-lead and payroll on the case.
trent-engmgr: Got it. If payroll approves the manual entry, will Yasmin see the retro as a single line on the 1/15 paystub?
luis-peopleops: Yes, typically the retro posts as a separate earnings line indicating the retro date range. Expect a follow-up from payroll about tax withholding; manual entries sometimes trigger tax reconciliations.
payroll-bot: Note: manual exceptions may incur additional processing time (2-3 business days) and could require payroll ops to process amended tax filings in some jurisdictions. Attach PDFs only; non-PDFs delay processing.
yasmin-ic: Thanks  that helps. Ill watch for the HR case update.
